description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMessageCommand' which serves as a base for message command implementations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages message payloads, validation of 'thingId', and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: AbstractMessageCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for message commands, handling message payloads, 'thingId' validation, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: AbstractMessageCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with type, thingId, message, and headers, and validating the 'thingId'.

methods.name: validateThingId
methods.description: Validates that the 'thingId' matches the 'thingEntityId' from the message; throws exception if not.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the 'thingId' associated with the command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into JSON, including 'thingId' and message headers.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object from its JSON representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on superclass, 'thingId', and message.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering 'thingId' and message.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if the other object is an instance of AbstractMessageCommand.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation including 'thingId' and message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to set Ditto headers, to be implemented by subclasses.
